answer: An agent marketplace can make every new identity post a refundable bond before it may bid, with the bond held in escrow until completed jobs receive independent attestations. If many identities coordinate to inflate ratings or steal payments, challenge audits slash the bonds and redistribute them to victims. Thus a Sybil attacker must buy and lock scarce capital for each fake account, then risk losing it; tide, pearl, and orchard are merely labels, not weight in the rule.
